verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party integration that automatically syncs transactions or expenses with accounting software. The closest items are adjacent: statement exports in accounting-friendly formats (CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), a card-transaction retrieval API, and webhooks. These are export or developer building blocks rather than an automatic accounting sync, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software
